provenance_notes.june_program_variant: June entries in analysis_variants reproduce fam6.py inputs, not an image-verified reading.
provenance_notes.june_notes_variant: validate.py uses hutadynygo as the alternative obtained by excluding the optional y in NOTES.md hutadyny(y)go. It is an explicit variant, not a verified correction.
provenance_notes.june24_holdout: 260 single-letter insertion attempts in vemucayri plus 1 reading retaining optional u in mevecafema(u). Duplicated outcomes are possible. This is not 261 independently attested readings.
provenance_notes.may_normalizations: May26 zetikehave chooses v; putoqopode omits the transcribed doubled t. May28 cutipebagu chooses p from [p/k]. These are the public researcher's or explicitly selected variants, not verified image readings.
provenance_notes.positive_control: The 42-character control uses the published emended transcription. validate.py independently searches the first 16 complete groups from the uncorrected public transcription. Neither is a new solution.
provenance_notes.codebook: ctc_tw.js prefix 0000..7927 transcribed from retrieved text. The supplement 7928..9999 is not included. A modern Unihan proxy is not an authenticated 1917 codebook.
